title: FROM THE BACK END TO THE RUNWAY
passages: I had spent years helping fashion and retail work through technology: APIs, platforms, payments, integrations. Then I began studying the experience from inside my own body.

Posture. Movement. A dip. A walk. Lessons with people who understood the craft and its history. I was learning a new language in public. The curiosity felt familiar, even when the movement didn't. After years of supporting experiences behind the scenes, I was giving myself permission to enter the scene.
